name: Raytac MDBT50Q-1MV2 nRF52840 module (chip antenna)
description: Certified Bluetooth LE module on the Nordic nRF52840 (Cortex-M4F 64 MHz, 1 MB flash, 256 kB RAM) with chip antenna, 32 MHz crystal and REG1 DC/DC inductor inside. 61 bottom pads: 48 GPIO (8 analog inputs, NFC), USB 2.0 full-speed device, SWD. Supply 1.7-3.6 V on VDD+VDDH or 2.5-5.5 V on VDDH; VBUS 4.35-5.5 V. 15.5 x 10.5 x 2.05 mm, 0.68 g.

params.note: Normal voltage mode: supply 1.7-3.6 V (typ 3.0 V) on VDD and VDDH together (Raytac §8.3 uses one 10 uF on both). High voltage mode: leave VDD off any supply; it then carries the REG0 output (1.8-3.3 V set by REGOUT0) and may feed external circuits up to 25 mA at <= 4 dBm TX, 5 mA above 4 dBm, 1 mA in System OFF. params.description: DCCH: Power, DC/DC converter output

params.note: REG0 DC/DC switch node. With REG0 DC/DC enabled (high voltage mode) connect an inductor from DCCH to VDD (Raytac recommends 10 uH, 0603, IDC min 80 mA, +-20 %). Unconnected in the reference circuit for inputs below 3.6 V (VDD and VDDH supplied together). Do not enable a DC/DC regulator without its LC filter.

params.note: USB 2.0 full-speed (12 Mbps) device controller with its own 3.3 V regulator fed from VBUS (4.35-5.5 V); VBUS also serves as plug detection.
SWDIO/SWDCLK are the debug and programming port. P0.18 (pad 40) is configurable as the system reset input.

interfaces.name: 2.4 GHz radio (Bluetooth LE, IEEE 802.15.4, ANT), chip antenna

params.note: Place the module at the board edge. No ground pad in any layer under the antenna: the antenna area is the 3.8 mm at the antenna end, kept clear as wide as possible beyond the module width; also no top-layer ground in a 1.6 x 1.2 mm area starting 2.95 mm from the left edge just below the antenna area (top view).
61 pads on the module underside, 0.6 x 0.4 mm in Raytac's recommended layout; module 15.5 x 10.5 (-0.15/+0.2) x 2.05 mm. MSL 2 (nRF52840 package rating).

params.note: The on-chip power-on reset may not work for rise times longer than the maximum.

params.flash: 10 000 write/erase cycles; 10 years retention at 85 C

params.note: Peripheral pins are assigned in firmware: any TWIM, SPIM, UARTE, PWM, I2S, PDM or QSPI signal can be routed to any GPIO. Only the full-drive pads (16-29, 36-49 except the supply and USB pads) suit SPI, I2C, UART and PWM; the low-frequency pads (3-14, 50, 52, 54, 56-61) are for signals up to 10 kHz. Analog inputs are fixed: AIN0-AIN7 on pads 11, 9, 20, 21, 13, 10, 14, 12.

Raytac ships the module with its test firmware in LDO mode, which needs an external 32.768 kHz crystal on XL1/XL2 (pads 17, 18; load capacitance up to 12.5 pF). DC/DC mode can be used without that crystal; with the internal RC oscillator omit the crystal and its capacitors. Without NFC, omit the NFC antenna and its capacitors.

params.resolution: The newer dimensioned drawing is used for the shield outline; its 1.2 mm height (2.0 mm top over a 0.8 mm PCB) comes from the STEP and agrees with the 2.0 mm in §2.1.

params.reason: GPIO high level equals VDD (normal voltage mode, 1.7-3.6 V) or REGOUT0 (high voltage mode, 1.8-3.3 V); the parameter states the union so a 3.0 V or 3.3 V rail checks against it (PS §5.3.1.2).

params.value: 0.6 x 0.4 mm at the §2.2 centres, 0.02 mm thick
params.reason: Raytac dimensions the recommended solder pad layout and shows the module pads at the same places (§2.1 bottom view) but gives no separate module pad size or plating thickness.

params.value: centred in width, 0.4 mm from the pad-edge end
params.reason: The 2D drawing dimensions the shield (9.7 x 11.1 mm) but not its offset; 0.4 mm is measured off the Ver. L §2.1 top view (the 2018 STEP places its smaller shield 0.45 mm from that edge). The STEP's 1.9 x 0.5 mm PCB slot is not modelled.

params.note: Raytac's design-guide archive (MDBT50Q & MDBT50Q-P & MDBT50Q-U Footprint_Design Guide 230606) contains 'MDBT50Q 3D Drawing_20180620.stp', an envelope solid without pads. No licence or terms are stated on the download page or in the archive, so it is not redistributed; it was used only to measure the PCB thickness, shield and antenna.
